claim: A new study in monkeys suggests that treating HIV infection early with antiretroviral therapy reduces the number of latent viruses.
source: A new study in monkeys suggests that treating HIV infection early with antiretroviral therapy reduces the number of latent viruses, but has little impact on viral reactivation when treatment stops.
evidence: The abstract references findings from a study conducted in monkeys examining the effects of early antiretroviral therapy on HIV infection.
